title: Scorecard composition is deterministic over a fixed reading set
statement: computeScorecard(readings, integration_head, timestamp) MUST return a Scorecard whose substrate × property cells, substrate_aggregates, and overall verdict are a pure function of the input readings (and the static degenerate-cell table). Re-running with the same inputs MUST produce byte-identical output modulo the timestamp.
rationale: Article 33 makes the scorecard the auditor's canonical state estimate of the framework. Non-determinism in composition undermines every downstream comparison: scorecard-over-time, regression detection, backlog refresh. The composition must be a pure function of explicit inputs. Article 39 (explicit uncertainty over false precision) further requires that scorecard verdicts honestly distinguish UNKNOWN from PASS.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
